datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule across Ethiopia in 2022. The spatial data represents acute food insecurity phases classified according to IPC standards, which serve as impact indicators of underlying drought hazards affecting food security.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity phases as a proxy for drought-related food security impacts.
